owner.description: Optional (additive, E10-F01). Coarse epic-level ownership. Absent ⇒ epic unowned; a feature with no owner of its own falls back to this. Not required; absence keeps existing stores valid.

status.$comment: Epic lifecycle: draft → planned → in-progress → done. `pending` is a legacy alias of `planned` (gating-equivalent, kept for backward compatibility). Feature/slice status enums are separate and unchanged.

owner.description: Optional (additive, E10-F01). Fine feature-level ownership. Absent ⇒ falls back to the parent epic's owner (effective owner). Not required; absence keeps existing stores valid.

parked.description: Optional (additive, E06-F07). Hold a real feature that is not yet workable — external blocking, where depends_on covers only board-internal blocking. PRESENCE MEANS PARKED: the selector emits a `parked` blocker and never selects it, while leaving featureRoute untouched, so unparking restores the prior routing exactly. A FIELD, not a status value: a park can arrive after speccing, so it must compose with every status rather than replace one. `reason` is required and non-empty — a park with no legible reason is the defect this fixes. Features only; slice parks are deliberately out of scope.

pr.description: PR URL the child SDD loop opened; a valid `gh pr view` selector for the merge poll

allOf.$comment: Cross-field: a sliced feature may only be `done` when every slice is done AND merged. Single-repo features (no slices) are unaffected — the `if` is false without slices.
